column1: # The digest is the SHA-256 of the MATCHED LINE with leading and trailing
# whitespace stripped, no other normalisation, hashed with NO trailing
# newline. The key is (rule-id, digest). Blank lines and lines beginning
# NO ENTRY MAY REPRODUCE A MARKER. The reason names the class and the site in
# prose and nothing else. History is append-only: a secret-shaped literal
# committed here would be reported by scripts/scrub-history.sh on every
# future run, permanently, and could not be removed without a gc — the
# allowlist would manufacture the very population it exists to resolve.
# scripts/scrub-history.sh refuses to load a baseline that matches one of its
# own rules, so this is asserted rather than promised.
# Registration is a MAINTAINER ACT performed in the commit that adds the
# entry, with the reason written then, never batched afterwards. Two clauses
# keep it honest and both are exercised by `--self-test`:
#   * a registered line that is, stripped, EXACTLY its rule's marker form is
#     REFUSED — that is the shape a real committed key takes;
#   * a registered digest that suppresses nothing in a full run is a HARD
#   GUARD-PATTERN     a detection pattern quoted in a checker, a CI lane or a
#                     workflow — the string is the guard, not the secret.
#   FIXTURE-ASSEMBLY  a line that ASSEMBLES a fixture at run time from pieces
#                     (printf arguments, character classes), so the marker
#                     exists only while a self-test runs.
#   RECORD            a review record, decision or verification note quoting a
#                     marker as evidence of what was scanned for.
#   RESERVED-MAGIC    the reserved antseal vault-export format constant where
#                     it is SPECIFIED or DEFINED — the decision that reserves
#                     it and the const that declares it. A format constant
#                     this project owns is not key material.
#   TRACKER           a task/TODO row naming a marker as the subject of work.
# Derived from a full-store run at ae4e167 (wave 32): 612 raw hits in 407
# objects carrying 50 distinct (rule, digest) pairs between them. Every one
# was read and named by hand before it was written here.
